description: Synthetic review of a repository with no declared command: no predicate fires, runtime-validation.md is never opened, and the explicit no-command Validation entry still renders.
validation_entry: No repository command declared; none run.

input.command: cd $SKILL_DIR && for f in shared/policies/git-safety.md shared/policies/verdict-consistency.md shared/policies/file-reviewability.md shared/policies/remediation-guidance.md shared/templates/finding.md shared/templates/finding-rendering.md shared/templates/review-summary.md policies/invocation-approval.md policies/repository-state.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
